release_notes.headline_internal: Bound every unbounded path in the adv_status read so the host cap can never fire unclassified
release_notes.headline_external: adv_status no longer fails with an unexplained timeout
highlights: adv_status now always returns a complete result or a clearly-labelled partial result within its time limit, instead of an unexplained timeout
Partial results name what was unavailable and why, so no restart or log inspection is needed
Bounded the post-load enrichment step that ran with no time limit — the cause that survived the previous deploy of this fix
Stopped futile retries against a permanently-missing workflow, using a structural error code plus request-scoped state rather than error-text matching
The internal read budget is now derived from the host tool cap with a measured safety reserve and a CI-enforced invariant, so the two can no longer drift apart silently
